pois.name: 30 St Mary Axe
pois.description: Norman Foster's 2003 aerodynamic tower (180m), universally known as the Gherkin. Its spiralling diagrid structure reduces wind load by 50%.

pois.name: St Paul's Cathedral
pois.description: Wren's 1710 masterpiece (111m dome), rebuilt after the Great Fire. The Whispering Gallery carries a whisper 34m across. Wellington and Nelson are buried here.

pois.name: Tower of London
pois.description: William the Conqueror's 1078 fortress. Home of the Crown Jewels — the largest cut diamond in the world, Cullinan I, is mounted in the Sovereign's Sceptre here.

pois.name: Leadenhall Market
pois.description: Horace Jones's 1881 ornate Victorian iron-and-glass market. Harry Potter's Diagon Alley was filmed here. Pubs and restaurants under painted vaults.

pois.name: The Monument
pois.description: Wren's 1677 Doric column (62m) marking the origin of the 1666 Great Fire. Its height equals its exact distance from the bakery where the fire started.
